review_notes: I read the whole file. It adds two lemmas about generic points of finite irreducible sets and two instances: finite spaces are QuasiSober, and finite T0 spaces are SpectralSpace. All of these use Mathlib's own IsGenericPoint, QuasiSober and SpectralSpace, so the file defines no competing concept. I grepped Mathlib's Topology, Spectral and Sober files, and the other files that mention QuasiSober or SpectralSpace. I found no existing instance for finite or Noetherian spaces being QuasiSober, and none for finite T0 spaces being spectral. The only quasi-sober instance I saw is R1Space.quasiSober, which doesn't cover finite non-R1 spaces. I did not search every Mathlib file for a generic-point lemma on finite sets, so a duplicate could exist under a name I didn't try. Any overlap would be a theorem duplicate, which the rubric excludes, so I'm abstaining.
